Order 
This first application under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.142 of 2025 of Police Station-Hanumana, District-Mauganj (MP) for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly established physical relations with prosecutrix from 09.12.2021 onwards on false pretext of marriage and also demanded Rs.5,00,000/- and one motorcycle as dowry.

4 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits in the instant case, prosecutrix is aged 22 years old,
she is educated lady and a graduate.
It is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37210 2 MCRC-23792-2025 also urged that as per prosecution case, allegation of physical relation is from 09.12.2021 to 2025.
It is also urged that it is a case of consensual relationship.
Further, the marriage between the parties was fixed for 20.04.2025, but prior to that, someone threatened applicant that if he performs the marriage, then, he would be killed.
Therefore, marriage could not took place.

1 present also, applicant is ready to marry prosecutrix.

entities.text: Nilesh Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
5. Learned counsel for the objector as well as learned counsel for the State submits that in Investigation, no threat as alleged by the applicant was even made.
Further, applicant demanded Rs.5,00,000/- and one motorcycle and when aforesaid demand was not met, then, he refused to marry the prosecutrix.
Therefore, they pray for dismissal of this application.
6. Having regard to nature of the dispute as well as evidence available on record and factual matrix of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.

8 . The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 482(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and shall cooperate in the investigation otherwise this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
